name: Miyakubo (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Miyakubo town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Flag of the former town of Miyakubo in Ehime Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-01-16. Flag and emblem were adopted on 14 March 1974.

features.role: Miyakubo town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes
